work=root/'.lake/build/executable-pipeline-input-independent-review-20260913'
class MS(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('length',ctypes.c_ulong),('load',ctypes.c_ulong)]+[(x,ctypes.c_ulonglong) for x in ['total','avail','totalpage','availpage','totalvirtual','availvirtual','extended']]
def memory():
    m=MS();m.length=ctypes.sizeof(m)
    assert ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(m))
    return m.avail
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
plan=json.loads((work/'plan.json').read_bytes())
for s in plan['sources']:
    assert sha(pathlib.Path(s['path']))==s['sha256']
    assert not (work/'lib/lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/(s['module']+'.olean')).exists()
for d in plan['dependency_copies']:
    assert sha(pathlib.Path(d['receipt']))==d['receipt_sha256']

manifest=root/'lake-manifest.json'
assert sha(manifest)=='825d2e1a20005a259fdf5b181528b391dd6ba18a52c86127caf4c3be990e04f0'
pins={}
for p in json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())['packages']:
    head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root/'.lake/packages'/p['name']),'rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
    assert head==p['rev'];pins[p['name']]=head
lean=pathlib.Path('C:/Users/Dan/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0-rc2/bin/lean.exe')
version=subprocess.check_output([str(lean),'--version']).decode().strip()
assert '6a10ac8c22beadecabdbb0919c2b50214762f91d' in version
env=os.environ.copy();env['LEAN_NUM_THREADS']='1';env['PYTHONUTF8']='1'
env['LEAN_PATH']=';'.join([str(work/'lib/lean')]+[str(root/'.lake/packages'/p/'.lake/build/lib/lean') for p in pins]+[str(lean.parent.parent/'lib/lean')])
for entry in json.loads((work/'copies.json').read_bytes()):
    assert sha(pathlib.Path(entry['source']))==entry['sha256']
    assert sha(pathlib.Path(entry['output']))==entry['sha256']
diag=work/'diagnostics';diag.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for name in ['ExecutablePipelineInput','ExecutablePipelineInputChecks']:
    pre=memory();assert pre>=805306368,pre
    source=root/'lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/f'{name}.lean'
    out=work/'lib/lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness'/f'{name}.olean'
    log=diag/f'{name}-{time.time_ns()}.log';meta=log.with_suffix('.json')
    cmd=[str(lean),'-R','lean','-o',str(out),str(source)]
    assert name in ['ExecutablePipelineInput','ExecutablePipelineInputChecks']
    before=sha(source)
    (diag/(name+'-source-'+before+'.lean')).write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    with log.open('wb') as f:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print('LIVE',name,proc.pid,str(log),flush=True)
        low=pre;stopped=False
        while proc.poll() is None:
            mem=memory();low=min(low,mem)
            if mem<671088640:proc.terminate();stopped=True
            time.sleep(.25)
        rc=proc.wait()
    record={'command':cmd,'cwd':str(root),'exit_code':rc,'guard_stopped':stopped,'memory_pre':pre,'memory_min':low,'source_sha256':before,'source_unchanged':before==sha(source),'log_path':str(log),'log_sha256':sha(log),'output_sha256':sha(out) if rc==0 else None,'LEAN_PATH':env['LEAN_PATH'],'LEAN_NUM_THREADS':'1','version':version,'manifest_sha256':sha(manifest),'pins':pins}
    meta.write_bytes(json.dumps(record,indent=2).encode('utf-8'))
    print(log.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),flush=True)
    print('ACTUAL_EXIT',rc,'METADATA',str(meta),flush=True)
    if rc or not record['source_unchanged']:sys.exit(rc or 2)
